parsed_response.summary: An L-shaped kitchen with a main base-and-wall run, a return wing with a tall tower, a separate tall upper unit, and one continuous worktop.

blocks.name: Main run base, left section
blocks.contains: Three base doors on the left end of the main lower run.
blocks.reason: Split from the five-door run to keep no more than three front positions across the carcass. The split point is assumed from the even door spacing.

blocks.name: Main run base, right section with corner stack
blocks.contains: Two base doors, plus the corner door above two stacked drawers.
blocks.reason: Covers the remaining main-run base and corner. The three side-by-side positions are two doors plus the corner stack. The split from B01 is assumed.

blocks.name: Main wall tall-over upper cabinets
blocks.contains: Three portrait upper doors on one upper carcass over the right end of the main wall.
blocks.reason: Three side-by-side fronts sharing one upper run, within the front-position limit.

blocks.name: Main wall middle upper lift-up pair
blocks.contains: Two wide horizontal lift-up fronts on the middle upper section.
blocks.reason: Two lift-up fronts sharing one wall cabinet. The shared carcass is an assumed grouping.

blocks.name: Tall upper unit at main wall left end
blocks.contains: One tall upper cabinet with one front at the left end of the main wall.
blocks.reason: Tall narrow unit kept as its own block. It is treated as a separate hanging unit, so it is not merged with the neighbouring upper run.

blocks.name: Return wing upper pair
blocks.contains: Two tall portrait doors on a separate upper cabinet in the return wing.
blocks.reason: Separately hanging upper pair, kept separate from the base run.

blocks.name: Return wing base, door section
blocks.contains: Three base doors on the left part of the return wing base run.
blocks.reason: Three side-by-side fronts on one base carcass, within the front-position limit. The split is assumed from the joints.

blocks.name: Return wing base, drawer and end door section
blocks.contains: A stack of three drawers and the end base door beside it.
blocks.reason: Drawer stack and end door make two side-by-side positions, within the limit. Assigning F20 here is an assumed grouping.

blocks.name: Return wing tall tower
blocks.contains: One tall tower cabinet with a single tall front at the end of the return wing.
blocks.reason: Tall tower kept as one full-height block, as a tall narrow unit.

front_conflicts.reason: The tall front may be a fixed panel rather than a door. The leaf boundary is not explicit, so it is kept as a single tall block.

uncertainties: The grouping of the main run base into B01 and B02 is an assumed split to respect the three-front limit.
F20 is assigned to B08 because it sits at the right end of the return wing base; its carcass boundary is not explicit.
The worktop extent over the return wing and the corner is estimated from the axonometric view.
Whether F24 is a door or a fixed panel affects whether B09 has a front at all.
